items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you see my cousin? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Which one? Lionel, his son, Lionel. He got a son here. He's a drummer.

ctx.x: Well, fish will go bad in a hurry. Hmm? Say fish will go bad in a hurry, I guess. Do you see my cousin?
Which one? Lionel, his son, Lionel. He got a son here. He's a drummer.
Lionel Jones? Sure. I never met him. How did Richard M. Jones get that nickname?
